answer_1.quote: We demonstrate its value for the evaluation and comparison of LLM-powered dialogue systems, in an information-seeking dialogue task...

answer_2.quote: We present LLM-RUBRIC—a rubric-based framework for automatic evaluation of text...

answer_3.quote: for each rubric question we elicit the LLM's probability distribution over possible responses, by prompting it with the text and the rubric question...

answer_4.quote: each user-AI dialogue is evaluated by 3 trained annotators (randomly drawn from a larger pool) who each answered the same 9 rubric questions...
answer_4.guideline: The rubric includes questions on naturalness, relevance, attribution, citation quality, conciseness, and overall satisfaction
